# Ontology-Constrained Information Extraction and Triplet Mining

> Extracting schema-conformant knowledge triples using constrained decoding, ontology schema constraints, and automated SHACL validation.

## Core Findings

- Closed-schema ontology-constrained extraction binds LLM-generated triples to predefined entity types and relation taxonomies, reducing relational hallucination rates compared to unconstrained OpenIE. [Source: https://aclanthology.org/2021.findings-acl.418/]
- Constrained decoding (grammar-guided token sampling via CFG or JSON Schema) guarantees syntactic validity of extracted graph triples at zero post-processing rejection cost. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09702]
- Automated SHACL validation against extracted RDF/property graphs detects missing mandatory properties, type mismatches, and orphan relationships before persistence into canonical memory stores. [Source: https://www.w3.org/TR/shacl/]
